Miami healthcare marketing

Healthcare Marketing and Medical SEO in Miami for Doctors and Clinics

Miami practices market to a bilingual population spread across dozens of separate cities and neighborhoods, in competition with large health systems and networks. Healthcare marketing in Miami works when each office is accurately represented, each physician and specialty has a real page, language support is honest, and calls and requests are measured. We provide that work remotely from Houston, with a shared task list and monthly video reviews.

We do not have a Miami office. We are a marketing and website agency, not a healthcare provider.

Availability depends on specialty and ZIP code. In Miami, plastic surgery, primary care and dentists are reserved. Practices in reserved categories can request a complimentary audit.
Request a free Miami practice review

  • Serving Miami remotely

How Miami differs

What makes healthcare marketing in Miami different from other markets

Three features shape almost every Miami engagement: geography split across many municipalities, a patient base that often prefers Spanish, and strong competition from networks with large directories. A single generic ‘services’ page loses on all three.

Many cities, one metro

Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Doral, Hialeah and Aventura are separate cities; Brickell and Kendall are not. Listings and pages must reflect where offices really are.

Bilingual expectations

Patients often expect Spanish, but translated pages only help when staff can respond in Spanish.

Network-scale competitors

Large groups publish detailed physician and location directories; independent practices need equally clear structure.

AI summaries

AI assistants summarize practices from scattered sources; inconsistent facts lead to vague or wrong answers.

Specialties we cover in Miami

  1. Cardiology and vascularOpen, ZIP check
  2. GastroenterologyOpen, ZIP check
  3. Urgent care and ERExisting Miami page
  4. Plastic surgeryAudit only
  5. Primary care, dentistsAudit only

Services

What we help Miami practices improve

We commit to the work and the reporting. Map-pack positions, AI mentions and patient numbers cannot be guaranteed.

Technical SEO

Speed, mobile layout, errors, forms and structured data fixed first.

Local SEO and Google Maps

One accurate profile and page per office, with consistent directory data and a review routine.

Physician and specialty pages

Pages for each provider and specialty, stating offices and languages, approved by your clinicians.

Spanish content where supported

Spanish pages reviewed by your bilingual staff and routed to people who can respond in Spanish.

Healthcare Google Ads

Campaigns for chosen services with ad-policy review and dedicated landing pages.

AI search optimization

Clear, consistent practice facts and answer-style content for AI search tools.

Medical content strategy

A content plan that matches what you offer and what patients ask, reviewed clinically.

Analytics and reporting

Calls, forms and requests by office, campaign and language.

See also healthcare SEO and healthcare AI search optimization. Miami practices can read our Miami local SEO guide for clinics.

Process and evidence

How remote healthcare marketing for a Miami practice works

One practice contact, a shared task list, monthly video reviews and accounts that stay in your name.

  1. Free review

    Screen-shared look at your search, Maps and AI visibility.

  2. Assess

    Audit of site, listings, directories, language support and tracking.

  3. Fix foundations

    Technical repair, office data and measurement.

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Physician, specialty and office pages; Google Ads if wanted.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly report and adjustments.

Illustrative example

How we would approach a multi-location cardiology group in Miami

Hypothetical scenario, not a client.

  • Collect facts per office: clinicians, testing, hours, languages.
  • Rebuild office pages so each states real differences.
  • Link each cardiologist to the offices they cover.
  • Track calls and forms by office and language.

What marketing cannot guarantee: rankings, Maps positions, AI mentions or appointment volume.

Miami coverage

Healthcare marketing across Miami-Dade

We serve Miami practices remotely and check availability by specialty and ZIP code. Offices in Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Doral, Hialeah or Aventura are in separate cities; Brickell, Downtown and Kendall are neighborhoods or unincorporated areas. We reflect that accurately in listings and pages.

Specialty offers

Miami specialty pages

  • Gastroenterology marketing in Miami
  • Cardiology marketing in Miami
  • Plastic surgery website audits in Miami
Existing pages

Urgent care

  • Urgent care SEO Miami
  • Med spa SEO
Reserved in Miami

Plastic surgery, primary care, dentists

Reserved for existing clients. Complimentary audit and consultation available.

Florida availability overview

Engagement and pricing

Short projects or ongoing work, satisfaction-based, cancellable with 7 days’ notice. Proposals are scope-based after review, with management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time website work and optional services separated. See our cost guide and the healthcare marketing hub.

Questions and consultation

Miami healthcare marketing FAQs

Answers for Miami practice owners and administrators.

What does healthcare marketing in Miami involve?

Accurate office listings, physician and specialty pages, technical repair, language-appropriate content, optional Google Ads, AI-search readiness and reporting, adapted to Miami-Dade’s geography and bilingual population.

Do Miami practices need Spanish-language pages?

Many benefit, but only when staff can answer Spanish calls and forms and a fluent team member reviews the content. Otherwise the pages create expectations the office cannot meet.

How does Google Maps work for a medical group with several offices?

Each eligible office needs its own verified profile, correct categories and hours, and a matching office page. Merged or inconsistent listings confuse both patients and Google.

Can you guarantee map-pack or AI results?

No. We control the quality and consistency of your information and pages; Google and AI providers decide what they show.

Which specialties do you work with in Miami?

Most medical specialties, subject to availability. Plastic surgery, primary care and dentists are currently reserved in Miami.

Can you optimize a website built by another company?

Yes. Most of our work is on existing sites, with your vendor or directly where you allow.

Do you have an office in Miami, and do we need an agency near us?

We have no Miami office; we are Houston-based and serve Miami remotely. Proximity matters less than specialty understanding, responsiveness and honest reporting.

Request a free Miami practice review
